headline: Google launches Universal Cart shopping tool in US
summary: Google's Universal Cart, previewed at its May I/O event, is now rolling out in the US across Google Search and the Gemini app ahead of the holiday shopping season; one outlet says Google unveiled two new shopping tools.

claims.statement: Google launched the Universal Cart shopping tool, rolling out in the US across Google Search and the Gemini app.

sources.quote: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.
now rolling out in the US across the Gemini app and Google Search

claims.statement: Google previewed the Universal Cart tool at its I/O event in May.

sources.quote: Google's intelligent AI shopping cart is finally here, and just in time to tempt users into Black Friday and seasonal holiday spending. The Universal Cart tool Google previewed at its I/O event in May

claims.statement: Google unveiled two new shopping tools ahead of the holiday buying season.
